title: Abyssals v0.90.64 — Preview rollback to v0.90.62 gameplay
notes: Forward-rollback of v0.90.63 preview to the published v0.90.62 gameplay, with an Android versionCode of 159 so it installs over preview 158 without uninstalling. Retains inert Spindle item identifiers and accepts already-created Spindle eggs in saves. Export a JSON save backup first. Original signing identity is unchanged. The old game does not generate new Spindle eggs. Branch-only prerelease: main and production PWA are unchanged.
